== Featured article ==
{{Featured article}}

== Set your spoiler level ==
'''This wiki will not spoil you.''' Use the spoiler strip at the top of any article to set how
far you've read '''in each series independently'''. Every fact is tagged with the book that
reveals it; anything past your progress stays hidden — including infobox rows and category
labels. See [[Project:About]].

== New here? ==
* '''Set your spoiler level first''' — the strip at the top of every page. Pick the last book you finished in each series; anything past it stays hidden.
* '''Start from a book''' — [[Unsouled (novel)|Cradle]] · [[House of Blades (novel)|The Traveler's Gate]] · [[Of Sea and Shadow (novel)|The Elder Empire]] · [[The Captain (novel)|The Last Horizon]]. Every book page is a hub into its characters, places and magic.
* '''Check the source''' — open ''Sourced facts'' under any paragraph, or follow a chapter footnote, to see exactly where in the books a fact comes from.
* '''Ask the Books''' (sidebar) searches the text itself when the wiki doesn't have the answer yet.

== Every fact is grounded ==
Seeded from the books themselves: each fact's supporting quote is verified '''verbatim''' in the
text, an independent judge confirms the quote supports the claim, and prose is original summary —
never copied, never invented. After seeding, editors own the wiki; the pipeline never overwrites
human edits.

== Want to help? ==
* '''Edit any page.''' The pipeline seeds articles from the books; it never overwrites a human edit.
* '''Found a gap?''' In ''Ask the Books'', select the passages the wiki is missing and '''Propose''' them — approved proposals become sourced facts on the page.
* '''House rules:''' original prose, quotes verbatim from the books, and every reveal wrapped in the [[Template:Spoiler|spoiler template]] so it gates by book. Details in [[Project:About]].
* '''Report a problem''' on the [https://github.com/cyrus104/cradle-wiki/issues wiki's issue tracker].
